title: Excellent app

author: Martu G

title: Great app
body: I’m enjoying this app so far! Question though how do you look at the notes you put in each Habit? The only way I can see them is I press Edit and go into the specific Habit.. is there another way?
author: lsteffler

title: Best habit builder I’ve seen in years.
body: You can make this app as complicated or as simple as you like.  Add as many different routines as you want.  The timer feature really helps.  Great for workouts, cleaning, or whatever you can dream up. No subscriptions !  Just one small payment (about half a starbucks drink). Remember:  you wouldn’t do your job for free. Don’t expect programmers to work for free either.  I also like that you don’t have to read a bunch of flowery, condescending ‘you can do it !’ messages either. *****

title: Great for tracking progress!

title: Great idea but......
body: This app is a great idea. I love the concept! However it only allows you to list 3 habits for free. If you want to list more than 3 at a time you’ve got to pay 3.99! I think they should allow people to list at least 8 - 10 habits for free and for those that are more serious and want to list more than 10 habits should pay. Great app but paying $4 to use it efficiently just isn’t worth it. Maybe to a select few but definitely not to the general public

title: Simple and effective
body:
I use other apps for actual Habit tracking but use this to keep track of my "dailies" - like drinking 8 glasses of water and updating MyFitnessPal. I really like the 0/2, 0/4 etc feature that visually shows you how far behind you are.

You guys are doing great and thank you for not charging an astronomical subscription for this - it made me buy it. Looking forward to the upgrades in the months to come.

title: Great App for Great Price!
